#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, btcAmount;
    cin >> n >> btcAmount;
    int btcCosts[100] = {0};
    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    int right = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int left;
        if (right == 0) {
            cin >> left;
        } else {
            left = right;
            right = 0;
        }
        if (left % 2 == 0) even++;
        else odd++;
        if (even == odd && i != n - 1) {
            cin >> right;
            int btcCost = abs(left - right);
            btcCosts[btcCost] += 1;
            even = 0;
            odd = 0;
        }
    }
    int sawedAmount = 0;
    int currentBTCCost = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < btcCosts[i]; j++) {
            currentBTCCost += i;
            if (currentBTCCost <= btcAmount) {
                sawedAmount++;
            } else break;
        }
    }
    cout << sawedAmount << endl;
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
